title: Side Quest
question:
The older they get the more they lean
But the familial bonds never die.
Find the FAMILY of four,
near the start of IISC's glory.

title: Side Quest
question: Near the house of proofs, shelters an old corridor, the one cool walk of its kind. Iron crosses over stone halfway along. Stone guards stand in two ranks, one on each side of you. Count each rank from end to end, bridge or no bridge, then let the two armies meet and bring back what they make when multiplied.

title: Side Quest
location: The Fishes at the entrance of Nesara
question:
A place of eateries that has REOPENED,
Houses little swimmers at its ingress.
How many, I wonder?

title: Side Quest
location: The Duck at the entrance of OPB
question: As you enter today's crowded venue by the entrance that isn't considered main, you will find the mascot greeting you and hiding something behind his back. What could it be?!

title: Side Quest
question: A lone neuron sits at the centre on some grass, while its copies hold a vigil around it. Join their positions with a line and tell me what shape their devotion draws.

title: Side quest
question: Its wings are clipped, yet it still stands watch over those who dream of flight. Find the one who hunts like a hawk, and bring back its SR number.

title: Side quest
question: Where minds are the specimen, a lone green thing on a throne counts its square courtiers each dawn. Envy has made it precise. Be as precise as it is, and bring back the count.

title: Side quest
question: A prominent DRDO scientist once visited a centre where technologies of high temperature molecules were exhibited. He planted a plant near, and now its your chance to find out the plant's name, before it dissapears.

title: Side quest
question: Victory you gain on the big red tower, Step on to the blue tiles of Alhambra.
